title: PLI SCHEME FOR AUTOMOBILE AND AUTO COMPONENTS
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Heavy Industries

PLI SCHEME FOR AUTOMOBILE AND AUTO COMPONENTS

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
21 JUL 2026 5:01PM by PIB Delhi

Government approved the PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry in India (PLI-Auto) with a budgetary outlay of Rs.25,938 crore for enhancing India’s manufacturing capabilities for Advanced Automotive Products (AAT) on 23/09/2021. The status of implementation of PLI-Auto scheme across all states (incl Rajasthan) is as below:-

Parameter

Cumulative till 31.03.2026

Investment (Rs. cr)

44,326

Incremental Sales (Base Year FY2019-20) (Rs. cr)

52,414

Employment generated (Nos.)

67,820

Incentive disbursed (Rs. cr)

2,386.36

To boost domestic manufacturing and localisation of AAT products, scheme mandates minimum Domestic Value Addition (DVA) of 50% for availing incentives under the scheme and as on 16.07.2026, 18 applicants have received DVA certificates for 154 products/variants.

PLI-Auto scheme is implemented on pan India basis (including state of Madhya Pradesh) and
approved applicants are free to set up units anywhere in the country. No special incentives are provided under the scheme to any state.

This information was given by the Minister of State for Heavy Industries, Shri Bhupathiraju Srinivasa Varma in a written reply in the Lok Sabha today.
